ported: OcrTransformation (buildRequest, parseResponse, pollUrl) as the adapter interface
parseOcrModel "<provider>/<model>" prefix and bare-id lookup, scoped to the selected adapter
handleOcr: document required, transformation dispatch, Mistral OCR response shape { model, pages: [{ index, markdown }], usage_info }
pollOcrOperation: same-origin status URL only, redirects refused, 30 attempts 1000 ms apart, failed state is a 502, exhausted polls are a 504
buildOcrSuccessResponse: accounting never turns a delivered result into an error; unknown cost stays unknown
notPorted: OCR_PROVIDERS entries (mistral, azure-document-intelligence, vertex-deepseek-ocr), their models, base URLs and auth: each belongs to a provider adapter
the "mistral-ocr-latest" default model and the "mistral-ocr-" prefix fallback: provider-specific
Vertex service-account token minting and project/region URL building: provider-specific auth
OmniRoute meta response headers and request ids: no DurinDoor equivalent

intentionalContractChanges: model is required and must resolve to the selected adapter (the source defaults to mistral-ocr-latest and picks the provider from the model)
the document must be exactly one of document_url or image_url (image_url may be { url }), a public https URL or a bounded base64 data URL of an accepted media type; the source forwards any value
top-level fields other than model and document are refused unless the adapter declares them; the source forwards the whole body
connection base URLs are not honored: requests and polls go only to the adapter's declared https origins
one deadline covers submit and polls; submit redirects are refused; bodies are read within caps
upstream error text is never quoted; failures after the document was sent carry acceptedJob and are never replayed
normalized pages keep index and markdown only, sorted by index; usage_info keeps primitive values only

exports.defineOcrAdapter: (spec) -> frozen adapter; throws TypeError on an invalid spec
exports.createOcrDispatcher: ({ adapters, fetchImpl?, sleepImpl?, timeoutMs?, maxResponseBytes? }) -> { dispatch, adapter, providers }
exports.validateOcrRequest: (adapter, body) -> { model, document, options }; throws ocrReject
exports.normalizeOcrDocument: (adapter, document) -> { type, source: url, url } | { type, source: inline, mediaType, bytes, base64, dataUrl }
exports.normalizeOcrResult: (parsed, { model }) -> { model, pages, usage_info? } or null
exports.ocrAcceptedJob: (provider, jobState) -> accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.ocrRefusal: (status, { provider, label, secrets, retryAfter }) -> failure result that never quotes the upstream
exports.ocrReject: (message) -> input error an adapter may throw from an option validator or buildRequest
exports.OCR_INLINE_MEDIA_TYPES: application/pdf and image/png, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff

required.origins: non-empty list of bare https origins; the only targets for the submit and every poll
required.models: static { id, name } rows (may be empty only with acceptsModel)
required.authHeaders: (credentials) -> headers or null; null refuses with 401 before sending. The foundation adds no auth of its own
required.buildRequest: ({ model, document, options }) -> { url, method? (POST|PUT), headers?, body? }; an object body is sent as JSON
required.parseResponse: (raw, { model }) -> { model?, pages: [{ index, markdown }], usage_info? }

optional.label: display name for messages
optional.acceptsModel: (id) -> boolean passthrough for ids outside models
optional.inlineMediaTypes: subset of OCR_INLINE_MEDIA_TYPES; [] refuses inline documents
optional.options: extra top-level request fields mapped to validators

dispatch.input: { provider, body, credentials, signal? }: the caller already selected the provider and connection
dispatch.success: { success: true, status: 200, provider, model, document (no inline bytes), body: { model, pages, usage_info? }, accounting, response }
dispatch.failure: createErrorResult shape; local: true when nothing was sent; acceptedJob when the provider may have done the work

acceptedJobStates.submit-unknown: the document was sent and no answer proves the outcome (5xx, redirect, transport error, deadline or abort before an answer)
acceptedJobStates.accepted: the provider answered 2xx and the result was lost (status check failure, failed analysis, exhausted polls, unreadable or malformed answer, deadline or abort after the answer)
